tooltip.polen.princess_seal.line1: The rightful seal of Princess Polen.
tooltip.polen.princess_seal.line2: It still carries the scent of royal honey.
tooltip.polen.princess_letter.line1: A letter written in shaky handwriting.
tooltip.polen.polen_journal.line1: The private journal of Princess Polen.
tooltip.polen.polen_journal.line2: Some pages are stained with honey.
dialogue.polen.chapter0.line3: Sorry... I don't usually talk to strangers.
dialogue.polen.chapter0.line4: This clearing is quiet. That's why I stayed.
dialogue.polen.chapter0.line5: Are you looking for somewhere safe too?
dialogue.polen.chapter1.line1: That place you're building... it looks safe.
dialogue.polen.chapter1.line2: I didn't think I would feel calm near other people again.
dialogue.polen.chapter1.line3: Maybe a small shelter is enough for now.
